expected_dishes.evidence: Cassava flour breaded chicken, served with house made ketchup

expected_dishes.name: Sesame Chicken Bowl
expected_dishes.evidence: Jasmine rice, crispy chicken with cassava flour breading, charred broccoli, sesame togarashi, scallions, ginger ponzu sauce

expected_dishes.name: Evolved Caesar Salad
expected_dishes.evidence: Farmer’s greens, sliced radish, pastured egg, avocado, gluten-free croutons, cashew “parmesan," herb ranch dressing

expected_dishes.name: Dark Chocolate Brownie

expected_dishes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookie

notes: Restaurant-wide statement '100% free of gluten, dairy, soy, peanuts, refined sugar & seed oils.' is a kitchen-level claim, which satisfies the celiac rule. The oat-based Plant Protein Patty is left out on purpose because oats are contested for celiac.
